name: dataflare-monorepo
description: Agent-first, open-source analytics that runs in your own Cloudflare account.

scripts.site:dev: node scripts/build.ts && node site/build.ts && pnpm --filter @dataflare/site exec wrangler dev
scripts.dev:wrangler: node scripts/build.ts && pnpm --filter @dataflare/worker exec wrangler dev
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && biome format --write packages/cli/CHANGELOG.md packages/web/CHANGELOG.md && node scripts/sync-version.ts
